evidence.title: GitHub - rbbydotdev/someday: Free to host calendar availability picker - open-source cal.com / calendly alternative built on Google-Apps-Script for Gmail users · GitHub

name: Someday
summary: Open-source Calendly alternative built on Google Apps Script: a calendar availability picker Gmail users can host for free.
description: A free-to-host scheduling tool for Gmail users: it runs as a Google Apps Script web app, reads availability from your Google Calendar, and gives visitors a booking page where they pick a date and time slot and leave their name, email, phone and an optional note. Work hours and the calendar are configured in backend/src/app.ts and via Apps Script properties; built with React, TypeScript, Shadcn/UI and Vite, deployed with clasp. A Vercel demo with mocked endpoints is available.
contains: free hosting through Google Apps Script on your own Google account
booking form asks name, email, phone and an optional note
availability read from Google Calendar; work hours customizable
multiple calendars via Apps Script Script Properties
React + TypeScript + Shadcn/UI + Vite frontend, deployed with clasp
demo with mocked endpoints at someday-demo.vercel.app
